approval_required_for: One additional pipeline_planning replay beyond bounded_attempts_per_stage=2 after the LLM/stage orchestration repair is complete.
Any architecture or pipeline-topology change, including adding/removing/reordering stages, changing branch/join semantics, residual skip sources, or stream/data-edge order.
Any model-shape or attention-policy change, including q/kv head counts, GQA grouping, head_dim, RoPE policy, causal mask policy, or sequence-length bounds.
Any numeric precision, rounding, saturation, tolerance, scale policy, accumulator width, or golden-output change.
Any memory-layout, AXI/DDR address-map, transfer-count, runtime ABI, or external KV-cache materialization change.
Any major template substitution, trusted-template boundary change, or free-form RTL generation outside approved bounded repair scope.
Any override of the failed-artifact trust barrier or attempt to consume the stale incomplete pipeline_planning_report.json.

executable_actions.on_failure: Stop the autonomous flow; do not run parameter_binding or consume any pipeline_planning artifacts until the trust barrier and SACG memory update are valid.
executable_actions.rationale: The latest command failed and the stale pipeline_planning_report.json is explicitly incomplete and unpromoted. A trust barrier prevents downstream tools from accidentally consuming failed current-stage artifacts while preserving the failure lesson in SACG memory.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep pipeline_planning blocked and stop to avoid artifact contamination; record the failed repair as a SACG failure lesson before any further retry is considered.
executable_actions.rationale: The failed attempt is localized to current-stage LLM/tool orchestration evidence: transient 504s occurred and memory_runtime_engineer terminated with a remote connection close, leaving team aggregation incomplete. Repair must be limited to LLM I/O, tool protocol, and current-stage role replay plumbing, not pipeline topology, numeric policy, memory layout, or template changes.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not proceed to parameter_binding. If failure is still transport/tool related, stop and keep the trust barrier active; if failure is checker-localized to a design inconsistency, create a bounded retry or backtrack request in SACG memory with the failed checker evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: A new current-stage run is needed to obtain complete pipeline_architect, memory_runtime_engineer, verification evidence gate, and team aggregate outputs, but the stage has already reached the configured attempt bound. The replay must be explicitly bounded, consume only the source SACG and repair/reconciliation artifacts, and promote outputs only if all current-stage checks pass.

proposed_actions: Stop downstream progress and keep parameter_binding blocked.
Create or update a SACG trust barrier marking the failed pipeline_planning attempt and stale report as non-consumable downstream inputs.

Run bounded repair of the pipeline_planning LLM/stage orchestration path using the command log and LLM policy, focusing on the memory_runtime_engineer remote close and team aggregation failure rather than changing architecture.
After repair, request approval for exactly one additional pipeline_planning replay because the retry bound has been reached.

During the approved replay, require complete role outputs, team reconciliation, and current-stage checks for stream plan, memory/runtime plan, boundary contracts, SACG/static consistency, model config, numeric policy, and template coverage before promotion.
If the approved replay still fails semantically, update SACG with a failure lesson and generate a bounded retry or backtrack request only from checker-localized evidence; do not proceed downstream.
